chunks: Ismaʿīl ibn Muslim narrated from al-Ṣādiq Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad, from his father, from his forefathers, peace be upon them, who said:

The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم ruled regarding a man who sold his palm trees but excluded one palm tree. He ruled that he had the right of access to it for entry and exit, and the extent of its fronds.

key_terms.الْمَخْرَجِ: the right of exit from it
key_terms.بِالْمَدْخَلِ: the right of entry or access to the retained tree
key_terms.مَدَى جَرَائِدِهَا: the outward reach or extent of its palm fronds
key_terms.نَخْلَةً: a single palm tree kept back from the sale
key_terms.نَخْلَهُ: his palm trees that were the subject of sale

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if someone sells palm trees but excludes one tree from the sale?
ai.summary: This hadith records a legal ruling of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم concerning the sale of palm trees when one tree is excluded from the sale. It establishes that the seller retains necessary access rights to the excluded tree, including passage to and from it and the spatial extent connected to its fronds.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3416 - Isma'il ibn Muslim narrated from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) from his father, Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as), from his forefathers (peace be upon them), who said:

"The Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace be upon him and his family) ruled regarding a man who sold his palm trees but excluded one palm tree. He ruled that the man had the right to access it for entry and exit, as well as the reach of its fronds."
